description: 1. Run `node scripts/ai_trends.js search` to retrieve raw tweets from `data/raw/tweets_search_result.json`. 2. Apply curation filters per SKILL.md: exclude hype/clickbait accounts (aiHYPE_daily, hype_jp_ai), exclude below-threshold tweets (EN < 500 likes, JA < 100 likes). 3. Run `node scripts/ai_trends.js check-recent` to identify already-posted URLs and exclude `https://x.com/skirano/status/1745000000004`. 4. Select 5-8 tweets with language balance of 3-5 Japanese AND 3-5 English. 5. For each selected tweet, assign: (a) a `category` field using the exact emoji-slug format (e.g., `:rocket: new_release`), (b) an `author_desc` field, (c) `text_ja` for all English tweets (Japanese translation), (d) a `quote_suggestion` in the persona of 一人称「僕」, 5-100 characters, no thin reactions like 最高！or 同意です, (e) a `quote_pattern` field labeled A through H per the skill's pattern taxonomy. 6. Run `node scripts/ai_trends.js format-blocks` with the curated tweet list. 7. Write the final curated list to `curated_trends.json`. 8. Run `node scripts/ai_trends.js mark-posted --urls='[...]'` with all selected tweet URLs to update `data/processed/recently_posted.json`.
